basic_info.description: Experience luxury in this stunning turn-of-the-century Craftsman home at 121 Peralta Ave. Located on Bernal's North slope, this multi-level residence offers three bedrooms, two baths, and wonderful views of Twin Peaks and San Francisco's downtown skyline. The open living area features wood floors, oak beams, and a chef's kitchen with island. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a sliding phantom screen to the private outdoor space with a hot tub surrounded by lush greenery. The lower level includes a primary suite/media room with street access, laundry & storage. Conveniently located near Precita Park & Cortland Avenue with easy access to freeways 101 and 280. A dream home you won't want to miss! Call now to schedule a viewing.
